assumptions_metadata.task_description: Proactively score currently enrolled students to flag high dropout risk for advisor outreach using admissions, semester performance, attendance, and finance status features.

assumptions.assumption: If Debtor = 1 then Tuition fees up to date = 0.
If Tuition fees up to date = 1 then Debtor = 0.
At least 85% of records have Tuition fees up to date = 1.

assumptions_on_column_groups.target_column_group: Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled),Curricular units 1st sem (approved),Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)

assumptions.assumption: Curricular units 1st sem (approved) is between 0 and Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled).
Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations) is between 0 and Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled).
If Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled) = 0 then Curricular units 1st sem (approved) = 0.
If Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled) = 0 then Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations) = 0.
Curricular units 1st sem (approved) <= Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled) - Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations).

assumptions_on_column_groups.target_column_group: Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled),Curricular units 2nd sem (approved),Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)

assumptions.assumption: Curricular units 2nd sem (approved) is between 0 and Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled).

import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    COL_TARGET = 'Target'
    COL_ATTEND = 'Daytime/evening attendance\t'
    COL_DEBTOR = 'Debtor'
    COL_TUITION_OK = 'Tuition fees up to date'

    COL_S1_ENR = 'Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)'
    COL_S1_APPR = 'Curricular units 1st sem (approved)'
    COL_S1_WO = 'Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)'
    COL_S1_GRADE = 'Curricular units 1st sem (grade)'

    COL_S2_ENR = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'
    COL_S2_APPR = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)'
    COL_S2_WO = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)'
    COL_S2_GRADE = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'

    COL_APP_ORDER = 'Application order'
    COL_INTL = 'International'

    COL_ADM_GRADE = 'Admission grade'
    COL_PREV_GRADE = 'Previous qualification (grade)'

    # ASSERTION_START
    tgt = df[COL_TARGET]
    valid = tgt.isin(['Graduate', 'Dropout', 'Enrolled'])
    assert tgt.notna().all() and valid.all()
    dist = tgt.value_counts(normalize=True)
    p_grad = float(dist.get('Graduate', 0.0))
    p_drop = float(dist.get('Dropout', 0.0))
    p_enrl = float(dist.get('Enrolled', 0.0))
    assert (0.45 <= p_grad <= 0.55) and (0.25 <= p_drop <= 0.35) and (0.15 <= p_enrl <= 0.25)
    # ASSERTION_END

    currently_enrolled_mask = df[COL_TARGET] == 'Enrolled'

    # ASSERTION_START
    adm = df[COL_ADM_GRADE]
    prev = df[COL_PREV_GRADE]
    assert adm.notna().all() and prev.notna().all()
    assert ((adm >= 0) & (adm <= 200)).all() and ((prev >= 0) & (prev <= 200)).all()
    corr = adm.corr(prev)
    assert pd.notna(corr) and (corr > 0.3)
    # ASSERTION_END

    adm_norm = adm / 200.0
    prev_norm = prev / 200.0
    academic_history_strength = 0.5 * adm_norm + 0.5 * prev_norm

    # ASSERTION_START
    att = df[COL_ATTEND]
    assert att.notna().all()
    assert att.isin([0, 1]).all()
    prop_day = float(att.mean())
    assert prop_day >= 0.80
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    intl = df[COL_INTL]
    assert intl.notna().all()
    assert intl.isin([0, 1]).all()
    assert float(intl.mean()) < 0.10
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    app = df[COL_APP_ORDER]
    assert app.notna().all()
    in_known = app.isin([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6])
    assert float(in_known.mean()) >= 0.99
    p_first = float((app == 1).mean())
    assert 0.60 <= p_first <= 0.75
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    debtor = df[COL_DEBTOR]
    tuition_ok = df[COL_TUITION_OK]
    assert ((debtor == 1) | (debtor == 0)).all() and ((tuition_ok == 1) | (tuition_ok == 0)).all()
    assert (tuition_ok[debtor == 1] == 0).all()
    assert (debtor[tuition_ok == 1] == 0).all()
    assert float((tuition_ok == 1).mean()) >= 0.85
    # ASSERTION_END

    finance_risk = ((debtor == 1) | (tuition_ok == 0)).astype(float)

    # ASSERTION_START
    s1_enr = df[COL_S1_ENR]
    s1_appr = df[COL_S1_APPR]
    s1_wo = df[COL_S1_WO]
    assert (s1_appr >= 0).all() and (s1_wo >= 0).all()
    assert (s1_appr <= s1_enr).all() and (s1_wo <= s1_enr).all()
    assert (s1_appr[s1_enr == 0] == 0).all()
    assert (s1_wo[s1_enr == 0] == 0).all()
    assert (s1_appr <= (s1_enr - s1_wo)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    s1_eval = (s1_enr - s1_wo)
    s1_pass_rate = (s1_appr / s1_eval.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)

    # ASSERTION_START
    s2_enr = df[COL_S2_ENR]
    s2_appr = df[COL_S2_APPR]
    s2_wo = df[COL_S2_WO]
    assert (s2_appr >= 0).all() and (s2_wo >= 0).all()
    assert (s2_appr <= s2_enr).all() and (s2_wo <= s2_enr).all()
    assert (s2_appr[s2_enr == 0] == 0).all()
    assert (s2_wo[s2_enr == 0] == 0).all()
    assert (s2_appr <= (s2_enr - s2_wo)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    s2_eval = (s2_enr - s2_wo)
    s2_pass_rate = (s2_appr / s2_eval.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)

    # ASSERTION_START
    s1g = df[COL_S1_GRADE]
    s2g = df[COL_S2_GRADE]
    assert s1g.notna().all() and s2g.notna().all()
    assert ((s1g >= 0) & (s1g <= 20)).all()
    assert ((s2g >= 0) & (s2g <= 20)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    sem_grade_norm = ((s1g + s2g) / 40.0)

    attendance_risk = 1.0 - att.astype(float)
    app_risk = (app != 1).astype(int)
    intl_risk = intl.astype(float)

    combined_academic = 0.4 * s1_pass_rate + 0.4 * s2_pass_rate + 0.1 * sem_grade_norm + 0.1 * academic_history_strength
    combined_academic = combined_academic.clip(0, 1)

    w_finance = 0.35
    w_academic = 0.30
    w_attendance = 0.15
    w_application = 0.12
    w_international = 0.08

    raw_risk = (
        w_finance * finance_risk
        + w_academic * (1.0 - combined_academic)
        + w_attendance * attendance_risk
        + w_application * app_risk
        + w_international * intl_risk
    )

    risk_score = raw_risk.clip(0, 1)

    dropout_base_rate = float((df[COL_TARGET] == 'Dropout').mean())
    threshold = max(0.5, dropout_base_rate + 0.25)

    enrolled_scores = df.loc[currently_enrolled_mask, [COL_TARGET]].copy()
    enrolled_scores['dropout_risk'] = risk_score.loc[currently_enrolled_mask].astype(float)
    enrolled_scores['outreach_flag'] = (enrolled_scores['dropout_risk'] >= threshold).astype(int)

    out_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'advisor_outreach_risk_scores.csv')
    enrolled_scores[['dropout_risk', 'outreach_flag']].to_csv(out_path, index=True, index_label='row_id')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import argparse
import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    COL_TARGET = 'Target'
    COL_ATTEND = 'Daytime/evening attendance\t'
    COL_DEBTOR = 'Debtor'
    COL_TUITION_OK = 'Tuition fees up to date'

    COL_S1_ENR = 'Curricular units 1st sem (enrolled)'
    COL_S1_APPR = 'Curricular units 1st sem (approved)'
    COL_S1_WO = 'Curricular units 1st sem (without evaluations)'
    COL_S1_GRADE = 'Curricular units 1st sem (grade)'

    COL_S2_ENR = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (enrolled)'
    COL_S2_APPR = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (approved)'
    COL_S2_WO = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (without evaluations)'
    COL_S2_GRADE = 'Curricular units 2nd sem (grade)'

    COL_APP_ORDER = 'Application order'
    COL_INTL = 'International'

    COL_ADM_GRADE = 'Admission grade'
    COL_PREV_GRADE = 'Previous qualification (grade)'

    # ASSERTION_START
    tgt = df[COL_TARGET]
    valid = tgt.isin(['Graduate', 'Dropout', 'Enrolled'])
    assert tgt.notna().all() and valid.all()
    dist = tgt.value_counts(normalize=True)
    p_grad = float(dist.get('Graduate', 0.0))
    p_drop = float(dist.get('Dropout', 0.0))
    p_enrl = float(dist.get('Enrolled', 0.0))
    assert (0.45 <= p_grad <= 0.55) and (0.25 <= p_drop <= 0.35) and (0.15 <= p_enrl <= 0.25)
    # ASSERTION_END

    currently_enrolled_mask = df[COL_TARGET] == 'Enrolled'

    # ASSERTION_START
    adm = df[COL_ADM_GRADE]
    prev = df[COL_PREV_GRADE]
    assert adm.notna().all() and prev.notna().all()
    assert ((adm >= 0) & (adm <= 200)).all() and ((prev >= 0) & (prev <= 200)).all()
    corr = adm.corr(prev)
    assert pd.notna(corr) and (corr > 0.3)
    # ASSERTION_END

    adm_norm = adm / 200.0
    prev_norm = prev / 200.0
    academic_history_strength = 0.5 * adm_norm + 0.5 * prev_norm

    # ASSERTION_START
    att = df[COL_ATTEND]
    assert att.notna().all()
    assert att.isin([0, 1]).all()
    prop_day = float(att.mean())
    assert prop_day >= 0.80
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    intl = df[COL_INTL]
    assert intl.notna().all()
    assert intl.isin([0, 1]).all()
    assert float(intl.mean()) < 0.10
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    app = df[COL_APP_ORDER]
    assert app.notna().all()
    in_known = app.isin([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6])
    assert float(in_known.mean()) >= 0.99
    p_first = float((app == 1).mean())
    assert 0.60 <= p_first <= 0.75
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    debtor = df[COL_DEBTOR]
    tuition_ok = df[COL_TUITION_OK]
    assert ((debtor == 1) | (debtor == 0)).all() and ((tuition_ok == 1) | (tuition_ok == 0)).all()
    assert (tuition_ok[debtor == 1] == 0).all()
    assert (debtor[tuition_ok == 1] == 0).all()
    assert float((tuition_ok == 1).mean()) >= 0.85
    # ASSERTION_END

    finance_risk = ((debtor == 1) | (tuition_ok == 0)).astype(float)

    # ASSERTION_START
    s1_enr = df[COL_S1_ENR]
    s1_appr = df[COL_S1_APPR]
    s1_wo = df[COL_S1_WO]
    assert (s1_appr >= 0).all() and (s1_wo >= 0).all()
    assert (s1_appr <= s1_enr).all() and (s1_wo <= s1_enr).all()
    assert (s1_appr[s1_enr == 0] == 0).all()
    assert (s1_wo[s1_enr == 0] == 0).all()
    assert (s1_appr <= (s1_enr - s1_wo)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    s1_eval = (s1_enr - s1_wo)
    s1_pass_rate = (s1_appr / s1_eval.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)

    # ASSERTION_START
    s2_enr = df[COL_S2_ENR]
    s2_appr = df[COL_S2_APPR]
    s2_wo = df[COL_S2_WO]
    assert (s2_appr >= 0).all() and (s2_wo >= 0).all()
    assert (s2_appr <= s2_enr).all() and (s2_wo <= s2_enr).all()
    assert (s2_appr[s2_enr == 0] == 0).all()
    assert (s2_wo[s2_enr == 0] == 0).all()
    assert (s2_appr <= (s2_enr - s2_wo)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    s2_eval = (s2_enr - s2_wo)
    s2_pass_rate = (s2_appr / s2_eval.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0.0)

    # ASSERTION_START
    s1g = df[COL_S1_GRADE]
    s2g = df[COL_S2_GRADE]
    assert s1g.notna().all() and s2g.notna().all()
    assert ((s1g >= 0) & (s1g <= 20)).all()
    assert ((s2g >= 0) & (s2g <= 20)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    sem_grade_norm = ((s1g + s2g) / 40.0)

    attendance_risk = 1.0 - att.astype(float)
    app_risk = (app != 1).astype(int)
    intl_risk = intl.astype(float)

    combined_academic = 0.4 * s1_pass_rate + 0.4 * s2_pass_rate + 0.1 * sem_grade_norm + 0.1 * academic_history_strength
    combined_academic = combined_academic.clip(0, 1)

    w_finance = 0.35
    w_academic = 0.30
    w_attendance = 0.15
    w_application = 0.12
    w_international = 0.08

    raw_risk = (
        w_finance * finance_risk
        + w_academic * (1.0 - combined_academic)
        + w_attendance * attendance_risk
        + w_application * app_risk
        + w_international * intl_risk
    )

    risk_score = raw_risk.clip(0, 1)

    dropout_base_rate = float((df[COL_TARGET] == 'Dropout').mean())
    threshold = max(0.5, dropout_base_rate + 0.25)

    enrolled_scores = df.loc[currently_enrolled_mask, [COL_TARGET]].copy()
    enrolled_scores['dropout_risk'] = risk_score.loc[currently_enrolled_mask].astype(float)
    enrolled_scores['outreach_flag'] = (enrolled_scores['dropout_risk'] >= threshold).astype(int)

    out_path = os.path.join(args.output, 'advisor_outreach_risk_scores.csv')
    enrolled_scores[['dropout_risk', 'outreach_flag']].to_csv(out_path, index=True, index_label='row_id')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
